payload.title: frick-server core: tokio+axum runtime, sessions, auth, config
payload.description: The server skeleton: axum/hyper HTTP + WebSocket endpoints speaking the frame protocol, connection/session lifecycle, auth + dev-login (handle globally unique per userId), policy hooks, config/env parsing (FRICK_* vars per docs/operations.md), structured shutdown contract, tracing/metrics. Both embed-as-library and standalone-binary entry points.
